definitions.explanation: A building where students or workers live together; communal housing.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}の{寮|りょう}に{住|す}んでいる。
examples.english: I live in a university dormitory.

examples.japanese: {寮|りょう}の{食事|しょくじ}は{安|やす}い。
examples.english: The meals at the dormitory are cheap.

examples.japanese: {社員|しゃいん}{寮|りょう}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: I moved into the company dormitory.

notes:
USAGE: {寮|りょう} refers to communal living quarters, typically for students or employees.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{学生|がくせい}{寮|りょう} (student dormitory)
・{社員|しゃいん}{寮|りょう} (company dormitory)
・{寮|りょう}に{入|はい}る (to move into a dorm)
・{寮|りょう}{生活|せいかつ} (dorm life)
・{寮|りょう}{費|ひ} (dormitory fees)

NOTE: Different from {ホテル} (hotel) or {旅館|りょかん} (Japanese inn) which are for temporary stays.
